title: AgentCapabilityRunResult.v1
description: The COMPACT, receipt-backed outcome of one AgentCapabilityRunRequest — what the gateway returns to the agent instead of the full raw corpus / tool-logs / reasoning chain. status is verified|succeeded|failed|unavailable (verified = Baltor governs the served facts; succeeded = a deterministic result with no truth claim; unavailable = could not run within policy/cost/freshness — e.g. a candidate runtime is not executed here). It carries the output, the source_handles that back any served facts, the held_out items (alternatives/contradictions kept separate, never silently dropped — lossless), the receipt_id, whether an LLM fallback_used, a tokens_saved_estimate (the agent's reason to call Teleon rather than re-solve), and the allowed_use carried forward. serves_truth is pinned const false: the gateway proposes/serves GOVERNED EVIDENCE under Baltor's rail; the result itself is never self-asserted, promotable truth.

request_id.description: echoes the request_id of the AgentCapabilityRunRequest

status.description: verified = facts governed by Baltor's verification rail; succeeded = deterministic result, no truth claim; failed = ran but errored; unavailable = could not run within policy/cost/freshness (candidate runtime not executed; capability not allowed)

output.description: the compact result of the capability; for context capabilities this is governed EVIDENCE (with source_handles), never self-asserted LLM truth

source_handles.description: the source handles that back any served facts (ctx://... / provenance refs); empty only when the capability serves no facts (e.g. a pure utility hash)

held_out.description: alternatives, contradictions, or superseded values kept SEPARATE and surfaced, never silently dropped (lossless distillation); e.g. a held-out '30 days' beside a served '10 business days'

receipt_id.description: id of the AgentCapabilityReceipt for this run; null only when status=unavailable and no receipt was produced

fallback_used.description: the token-ladder step actually used if it fell past deterministic (e.g. 'api', 'llm_fallback', 'human'), or null when the deterministic/cache hot path served it; an LLM step never makes the output truth

tokens_saved_estimate.description: estimated frontier tokens the agent saved by calling this governed capability instead of re-solving the workflow itself (the gateway's value metric)

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — the gateway serves governed EVIDENCE under Baltor's rail; a capability result is never self-asserted, promotable truth

allowed_use.description: the uses this output is governed for, carried forward from the capability + request
